listening_scenarios.scenario: 市役所:手続き案内
listening_scenarios.note: The pool tag did not describe the authored item. 「市役所:手続き案内」 was drawn with pools.json's theme 地域活性化, but the surface authored from it (聴解問題2-6番, 「市役所で市民センターの部屋を借りるのに次に持っていく物」) is an administrative-procedure errand end to end — the decisive turn is 「市内にお住まいの方が、会員の半分以上いることを見せていただく必要がありまして」, a rule about paperwork, and nothing in the item is about 地域活性化. logs/topics.json therefore records 行政・手続き for this surface, per exam-qa-review §5 ("Don't trust test_spec.json… a drafted passage can wander off its pool tag"), and this note is the reason the two records differ. RECORDED, NOT RECONCILED, on purpose: `theme` is left at the value the sampler drew so the ledger stays a faithful record of the DRAW, `scenario` is left byte-identical because sample_items.recency_map() keys on the pool string, and pools.json is NOT edited — one paper's authored surface drifting from a tag is a record-keeping fact about this paper, not a defect in the pool. QA measured that neither tag hides a collision: under either reading every theme count stays inside the <=5 listening cap and no headline theme moves. Source: F9 (qa/qa-report-20260821_1.md) and NF-4 (qa/qa-report-20260821_1-round2.md), whose own instruction to 'sync both files and record the reason' went unapplied for two rounds; check_theme_record_agreement() now reads this field.

listening_scenarios.scenario: ラジオ:睡眠の話
listening_scenarios.note: 聴解問題3-1番 ships as an in-person 健康づくりの講座 (「1番。健康づくりの講座で、女の人が話しています。」), not as the drawn ラジオ broadcast. Sanctioned at blueprint time, one reason: this paper drew TWO broadcast scenarios (「テレビ:地域の祭りの紹介」 and 「ラジオ:睡眠の話」) and `choukai-items.md` §"Section item mix" admits only ONE broadcast monologue in 問題3, so one of the two had to change medium; 「テレビ:地域の祭りの紹介」 kept the broadcast (問題3-5番) and this entry moved. ONLY THE MEDIUM MOVED — the subject (体内時計を合わせているのは寝た時刻ではなく起きた時刻の方だという睡眠の話), the key (「起きる時こくをそろえること」), the three distractors and the talk length (293 JP chars) are all as drawn. This is a RE-REALISATION of 「ラジオ:睡眠の話」, not a substitution and not a cancellation, so the `scenario` string is deliberately left AS DRAWN: `sample_items.recency_map()` keys on the pool string, so renaming it (qa-report-20260821_1 §Repairs F5 proposed 「健康づくりの講座:睡眠の話」, which is in no pool) would leave 「ラジオ:睡眠の話」 un-cooled and redrawable by the next paper, and would break `check_spec_pool_resolution` / `check_ledger_spec_agreement`'s resolution of this draw. Cooldown and rotation must keep treating 「ラジオ:睡眠の話」 as drawn and used by 20260821_1. Recorded because `check_choukai_drawn_items()` reads 問題1/2/4 only, so 問題3 is unchecked; the full account is in tests/20260821_1/聴解.md 問題3 構成表 (Stage-3 修正 F5). Source: QA finding F5, qa/qa-report-20260821_1.md.
